fact: Smart Africa and Uganda's Ministry of ICT workshop stakeholders named advancing the Startup Bill as a priority.
We Are Tech Africa reports Uganda proposes a three-year income tax exemption for startups as part of proposed amendments to the 2025 Income Tax Bill.
The Daily Monitor reports that a startup policy is being finalized by the Ministry of Trade before being presented to cabinet, and that Uganda currently lacks a startup policy.

Startup Uganda says the National Startup Act was under technical review at the trade ministry and advancing towards Cabinet, with the Attorney General's office and education ministry having reviewed the policy favourably.
ecosystem.build reports a 9th draft of the National Startup Policy presented in May 2024 and a private member's Startup Bill introduced in Parliament.
